text: When I call, give me answers. God, take my side! Once, in a tight place, you gave me room; Now I'm in trouble again: grace me! hear me!
How long will you lust after lies? How long will you live crazed by illusion?
Who got picked by God! He listens the split second I call to him.
Keep your mouth shut, and let your heart do the talking.
Build your case before God and wait for his verdict.
Than they get in all their shopping sprees.
For you, God, have put my life back together.
